review_notes.evidence: BL original source clearly prints0143C3/E-E3C5. A1 KX411 lists C1 and C2 at C5 but no C3,32 portions for33 source blocks. Retained native BL C3 with explicit mismatch; all32 other portions match.

Original footer exact.png has physically lost middle DATE digits. Human physical-copy reading is 02-29-71, retained literally despite 1971 having no February 29. Original scan neighbors in scan_neighbors identify source before and after.
Native title second line ends TERMINATIO at right border; retained clipped print without adding N. Header and both vertical KX411 identifiers agree with source filename.

All33 original-pixel gate crops and seven gate sheets inspected. AQ/2N load ID, CL upper B02, BM B13, BQ D04, CF D12, BB D12 at row54, AY B07✲, BG/BH input and output wedges, BL both input wedges and plain D02✲ output verified. Printed numeric prefixes retained. AT/AS lower K markers replace right border; AT lower D10 has no star. Inline 6 and 8 annotations at AT r27 and AS r28, L annotations on BR r69/r70 are wire text, not physical pins.

left rails exact.png and right rails exact.png independently trace separate c90/91/92 and c159/160/161 banks. Gate-any feeds CA.B09 and CJ.B09 only; gate1 feeds CA.D11 and CJ.B10; error force feeds AX.B13 and CF.B13; gate2 feeds AR.B07/CG.B07; gate3 feeds AZ.D05, CB.B03/D08, CH.D05, CK.D04/D08, including printed U-loops. Source gaps and unjoined crossings preserved. Native AT/AS physical K output rails explicitly share their same-block semantic drivers.

Original lower left/middle/output crops and all calibrated views independently checked. Clock c91r51–66 feeds BM.B13 at diamond63 and BN.D06. Separate feedback c91r73–89 feeds BP.B12 and BQ.D04, diamond84. AG upper B05 returns via c69r87–50 and c133r50–68 to BG.B07. BR output bends c131r68–75 to BH.B03 and c160diamonds75/82 feeds BJ.D13 and negativeoutput86. BG/BH immediate output bends preserve separated c176r66–68 and c176r70–75 segments. Printed degree-two diamonds retained; no automatic bend junctions.

Original footer/revision/table crops reviewed: DATE02-29-71 from physical copy, LOG983 FRAME02 P.N.2585345 SDD BLK.CM; six revision rows and two connector columns transcribed literally. Printer stencil P.N./MACH. fields end239, blank240. Parent independently confirmed connector entries and footer CM.

Root reviewed all nine calibrated native/text regions and original enlarged AT/AS annotation and AS table crops. Wire annotations at AT c115r27 and AS c184r28 read 6 and 8, respectively. AS connector continuation reads 02E-E3N2D06. These printed annotations are not physical pin numbers.
